#### 1. retinitis pigmentosa 101  —  Tier 1 — Definitive / Highly Plausible  (fitness 0.792)
**Link type:** shared pathway (Reactome:R-HSA-9845576)

**Proposed mechanism:** CLN3 (HGNC:2074) —DISRUPTS→ Lysosomal trafficking and function (GO:0005700); CLN3 (HGNC:2074) —DISRUPTS→ Autophagy (GO:0006914); Lysosomal trafficking and function (GO:0005700) —LEADS_TO→ Accumulation of autofluorescent storage material in lysosomes (HP:0002363); Autophagy (GO:0006914) —LEADS_TO→ Accumulation of autofluorescent storage material in lysosomes (HP:0002363); Accumulation of autofluorescent storage material in lysosomes (HP:0002363) —LEADS_TO→ Neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis (MONDO:0008767); Accumulation of autofluorescent storage material in lysosomes (HP:0002363) —LEADS_TO→ Progressive vision loss (HP:0000502); Progressive vision loss (HP:0000502) —LEADS_TO→ Retinitis pigmentosa (MONDO:0981164). Loss-of-function mutations in CLN3 disrupt both lysosomal trafficking and autophagy. This leads to the accumulation of storage material in lysosomes, causing the neuronal degeneration seen in NCL and the photoreceptor dysfunction characteristic of RP.

**How to falsify it:** The identification of a pathogenic variant in CLN3 with a minor allele frequency > 0.01 in gnomAD would suggest that the proposed loss-of-function mechanism is not the primary driver of these rare diseases. _(variant: rs759845042)_
